title: Add scrolling to Vault sidebar and NFT preview page

requirements.text: Add vertical scrolling to the Vault sidebar so that all sidebar content (layers, filters, controls) is accessible when it overflows the viewport height, without altering any existing sidebar styling, layout, or visual design.

quotes: Add scrolling to the sidebar and the NFT preview page within the Vault so users can view all content in the VAULT, without changing the current Vault design as in the existing Draft (Draft 169).

acceptanceCriteria: The Vault sidebar scrolls vertically when its content exceeds the available viewport height.
The sidebar scrollbar does not appear when content fits within the viewport.
No existing sidebar styles, colors, spacing, or layout are changed.
The sidebar header/title and any sticky controls remain visually anchored (do not scroll away if previously fixed).

requirements.text: Add vertical scrolling to the NFT preview panel/page within the Vault so that all NFT preview content (image, metadata, traits) is accessible when it overflows the available height, without altering any existing preview panel styling, layout, or visual design.

quotes: Add scrolling to the sidebar and the NFT preview page within the Vault so users can view all content in the VAULT, without changing the current Vault design as in the existing Draft (Draft 169).

acceptanceCriteria: The NFT preview panel scrolls vertically when its content exceeds the available height.
The scrollbar does not appear when all preview content fits within the viewport.
No existing preview panel styles, colors, spacing, typography, or layout are changed.
The overall Vault page layout (sidebar + main content + preview) remains structurally identical to Draft 169.

constraints: Do not change any existing Vault visual design, colors, typography, spacing, or layout structure.
Only add overflow/scroll behavior — no other CSS or component changes.
nonGoals: Redesigning or restyling any part of the Vault UI.
Changing scroll behavior on any page other than the Vault.
